### Operational Discipline

- **Compute format** — no teams, no SendMessage. Each agent runs as an independent Agent tool invocation with the full self-contained prompt below. Agents cannot communicate mid-computation. All dependency passing is via the working paper + saved artifacts between waves.
- **Trigger-phrase discipline** — every gate with `[SIGN]`, `[VERIFY]`, `[AUDIT]`, `[CHAIN]` prefix carries the substitution-chain requirement per `.claude/rules/math-scripts.md` §Double-Check Logic Before Compute. Agent prompts include the explicit invocation text.
- **4-tuple output tags** — all numerical outputs MUST carry (value, scheme, convention, L_max). Unspecified convention = automatic PRU (Class 8) flag on the result.

## VIII. Decision Points

### After Wave 0 (before Wave 1 dispatch)

**W0-15 verdict required for W0-14 to proceed.**
- If W0-15 = PASS Sc.A (7 branches): W0-14 canonicalizes 7 entries (add 2 to the synthesis-proposed 5). Wave 1 dispatches unchanged.
- If W0-15 = PASS Sc.B (5 branches, PRU closure): W0-14 canonicalizes the 5 as proposed. Wave 1 dispatches unchanged.
- If W0-15 = INFO (6 branches): HOLD W0-14. Escalate to user for resolution. Wave 1 proceeds WITHOUT canonicalization (not a Wave 1 blocker).
- If W0-15 = FAIL: HOLD W0-14. Escalate. Wave 1 proceeds.

**W0-1 / W0-2 verdicts do NOT block Wave 1** but condition Wave 2.

### After Wave 1 (before Wave 2 dispatch)

**Primary Branch Decision — W1-1 H̃-EPOCH verdict:**

- **If W1-1 converges (TD and lizzi within 20%):**
  - Wave 2 proceeds with ADJUDICATED H̃ as single input.
  - W2-1 replays UNIFIED-AS-79-FULL under single branch (confirmation run).
  - W1-2 verdict from Wave 1 is accepted as final.

- **If W1-1 FAIL-GT10 (both branches fail):**
  - UNIFIED-AS-79 framework-level A_s path is closed (similar to S79 A_s ledger retraction).
  - Wave 2 W2-4 PS-SUBSTRATE-MATCHED-IC becomes TOP priority (replacement IC mechanism).
  - Wave 3 W3-9 AS-ADJACENT-OBS elevated.

- **If W1-1 diverges (TD and lizzi differ by >20%):**
  - Wave 2 dispatches with BOTH branches (W1-2 reports conditional; W2-1 replays both).
  - Add S80-H-TILDE-DIVERGENCE-CHASE to Wave 2 as priority gate.
  - Implications table in §W1-1 comparison section.

**Secondary Branch Decision — W0-2 CLT drift verdict:**

- **If W0-2 PASS (drift_u1(L=8) ∈ [0.56, 0.76]):**
  - W2-3 KASPAROV-ABELIAN-PROOF uses dual-argument track (K-theory + CLT).
- **If W0-2 FAIL Sc.1 (<0.40, R holds):**
  - W2-3 uses K-theory-only track.
  - P4-B abelian-failure hypothesis REJECTED — document and update theorem-ledger.
- **If W0-2 FAIL Sc.2 (>0.80, stronger than CLT):**
  - W2-3 needs stronger integrability constraint; escalate to new theorem-candidate.

**Tertiary — W1-4 CC-Ratios-Only verdict:**

- **If W1-4 PASS (≤3-page proof):** Install in §VII.I. Cite in W2-1 replay and in all downstream A_s-related computations as ratios-only framework-observable.
- **If W1-4 INFO (≤6-page sketch):** Wave 3 W3-2 R-family atlas provides additional structural support.
- **If W1-4 FAIL:** CC-Ratios-Only theorem path closes. M_KK elevated to axiomatic-pin with no ratios-only bypass; all A_s-related work must carry M_KK-absolute tag.

### After Wave 2 (before Wave 3 dispatch)

- Wave 3 §VII.I theorem proofs proceed unconditionally; they are independent of Wave 1/2 verdicts.
- Phononic-length W3-11/W3-12/W3-13/W3-14 proceed if W0-14 PASSED; else deferred to S81.
- W3-9 AS-ADJACENT-OBS priority depends on W1-2 verdict (TOP if W1-2 FAIL, MEDIUM if INFO, LOW if PASS).

### Contingency (Rule-File Installs)

W0-10 rule-file install drafts: apply in S81 opening (not S80) to avoid rule-churn mid-computation.

## XI. Success Criteria

S80 is considered successful if ALL of the following hold:

1. **Wave 0 critical items complete** — W0-1, W0-2, W0-14 (or W0-14 documented-deferred per W0-15), W0-15 all produce verdicts; housekeeping W0-4 through W0-12 complete.
2. **Wave 1 critical items decisive** — W1-1 produces adjudication (PASS-F2 or FAIL-GT10 both count as decisive), W1-2 produces ratio-level verdict, W1-4 produces proof or sketch.
3. **Wave 2 A_s-cluster resolved** — W2-1 replay consistent with W1-2; W2-2 backreaction bounded or explicitly FAIL with escalation; W2-4 PS-IC computed.
4. **Two-axis tracking updated** — P_work_complete advanced by ≥0.02 (either from closed theorem candidates in Wave 1/2/3 OR from closed open-channels); P_obs_aligned either confirmed at 6/9 or updated to 7/9 (if W1-2 A_s passes) OR 5/9 (if W1-2 A_s fails and no adjacent observable recovers).

### Acceptable S80 FAILs (do not block S81 progress)

- W1-2 FAIL-GT15 — absolute A_s closed; framework pivots to ratios-only observables.
- W0-2 FAIL Sc.1 — R-protection holds at abelian; CLT track drops; K-theory-only Kasparov proof remains viable.
- Wave 3 INCOMPUTABLE on 1-2 theorem proofs — long-form proofs often require follow-up session iteration.

### S80 Unsuccessful if

- W1-1 INCOMPUTABLE (Friedmann evolution fails numerically) — blocks all A_s downstream.
- W0-15 structural FAIL — blocks canonicalization indefinitely without escalation.
- Combined W1-1 and W1-2 and W1-4 all FAIL — triple-decisive negative on A_s + ratios-only bypass; framework A_s position significantly weakened (but NOT closed; adjacent observables remain).
